title: Megumi Shimizu Dies as Dread Spreads Part 2

series.summary: Following Megumi Shimizu's shocking death, Natsuno Yuuki coldly tears up her postcard while Sotoba village prepares her tragic funeral and cremation, leaving Monk Seishin Muroi with a chilling realization that her life was stolen by an ominous presence in the Kanemasa mansion.

cuts.voiceover_text: Inside his quiet bedroom, Natsuno Yuuki stands frozen by the open window. Word of Megumi Shimizu's sudden death has just swept the village, but his face remains cold and guarded. For weeks, Megumi obsessively watched him from the dense shrubs below, yet now the yard is dead silent. Natsuno glances down at the handwritten postcard she sent him, picturing the European mansion on the hill. His jaw tightens with bitter irritation. Without hesitating, he tears the card into jagged pieces and dumps them straight into the trash.

The next morning, grief hangs heavy over Sotoba as the entire village gathers for Megumi's sudden funeral service. Her mother collapses beside the flower-draped altar, sobbing uncontrollably while neighbors rush forward to support her trembling shoulders. Dr. Toshio Ozaki stands nearby in grim silence, completely unsettled by how fast an otherwise healthy teenager deteriorated. Every villager feels the creeping sorrow in the room, but beneath the tears lies a chilling, unspoken dread. Nobody can explain how simple fatigue turned into an impossible, blood-draining death overnight.

Outside at the village crematorium, workers carefully slide Megumi's plain wooden coffin toward the glowing iron furnace. Her devastated father buries his face in his hands, unable to watch as the heavy steel doors seal shut with a hollow thud. Intense heat shimmers against the dark stone walls. High above the dense forest canopy, thick black smoke billows from the tall brick chimney, drifting slowly across the quiet Sotoba valley. Watching the dark plume rise, the mourners feel a chilling finality settle in, completely unaware that Megumi's tragic end is only the terrifying opening casualty.

Walking alone through the overgrown graveyard, Monk Seishin Muroi gazes at the weathered wooden stupas lining the secluded mountain path. His heart aches with profound sorrow over a vibrant young life violently cut short. Death is a natural part of existence, yet Megumi's sudden demise feels profoundly wrong, as if her stolen future was ripped away by a predatory force. As twilight descends over the quiet valley, Seishin looks up toward the ominous Kanemasa mansion looming silently on the ridge. The village believes Megumi is gone forever, but a far darker nightmare is already watching them from the shadows.
